column3: Close to the Hebrew; “courtyard of the guard” is rendered “court of the prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his mouth with his mouth… his eyes his eyes” is rendered “face to face… eye to eye.”
Close to the Hebrew; “give attention to” is rendered “visit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “right of possession” is rendered “right of inheritance,” and “courtyard of the guard” “court of the prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seven shekels and ten the silver” is rendered “seventeen shekels of silver,” and “silver” “money.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the order and the conditions” is rendered “according to the law and custom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord Yahweh” is rendered “Lord GOD.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֶסֶד (hesed) is rendered “lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mounds” is rendered “the siege mounds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “made smoke” is rendered “offered incense.”
